create_arcee_config: create an ArceeConfig instance with default AFM-4.5B-Base model parameters
build_arcee_causal_lm: build an ArceeForCausalLM model from a pre-trained Arcee checkpoint for text generation
build_arcee_sequence_classification: build an ArceeForSequenceClassification model for text classification tasks
build_arcee_question_answering: build an ArceeForQuestionAnswering model for extractive question answering
build_arcee_token_classification: build an ArceeForTokenClassification model for token-level classification tasks
